description:
𝗩𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗻𝘀 — yes, you 𝗖𝗔𝗡 buy a home with a friend, sibling, fiancé, parent, or another non-veteran. 🪖🏡

But here’s the part most people don’t know… 👀

When you use a VA loan with a 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝘃𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗻 who isn’t your spouse:

▪️ Both borrowers can use their qualifying income 💵
▪️ Both borrowers will be on the loan 📝
▪️ The VA guaranty applies only to the 𝗩𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗻’𝘀 portion of the loan ⚠️

For example, on a 𝗦𝟮𝟬𝟬,𝟬𝟬𝟬 home with a 50/50 split, the Veteran’s portion would be $100,000.

Because the non-veteran’s portion is not VA-guaranteed, the lender may require a 𝗦𝟮𝟱,𝟬𝟬𝟬 down payment — that’s 𝟭𝟮.𝟱% of the purchase price. 🤯💰

𝗦𝗼 𝘆𝗲𝘀, 𝗶𝘁’𝘀 𝗽𝗼𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗹𝗲 — but the structure of the loan matters. 💯

Exact requirements may vary based on entitlement, ownership percentage, and lender guidelines.
